scope.goal: Track whether each known audiotactile PPS literature record has a structured expected outcome and whether the current toolkit has observed evidence that can be compared against it.
scope.evidence_boundary: Protocol 12, static preview parity, one-block fake-audio runner stress, and synthetic loopback prove software scheduling, WAV generation, event/marker, and artifact contracts. They do not prove human behavioral PPS effects. Observed scientific outcomes require either collected participant data or an explicit synthetic-participant model whose assumptions are documented separately.
